Colossal, pulpy white worm. Oval, leech-like mouth encircled by dozens of eyes. Flies between stars, called the "Moon Grub" by sages.

AC 15, HP 99, ATK 3 bite (near) +10 (4d6) or 3 eye beam (far) +10 (3d6), MV far (burrow, fly, swim), S +6, D +5, C +5, I -3, W +4, Ch +4, AL C, LV 21

Freezing Mist. Far-sized cube of frosty mist centered on Yarthoon, lasts for 5 rounds. CON 15+ or frozen until mist dissipates. Obscures vision, spreads around corners.

Immortal. Only damaged by magic sources. Immune to cold. If slain, resurrects in 1d10 days and flees.

Starflight. Yarthoon can survive the interstellar void. Able to fly between worlds in 1d4 days.
